content:
Grouping by the ordering table (one mode per part number) and optical-characteristics notes per model. Wavelengths: 273396 variants use 1260/1270/1280 nm (TX); 332796 variants use 1320/1330/1340 nm. Data rate 10.3125 Gbps from ordering; 11.3 Gbps is only a max capability, not tied to a specific row. Applications/standards apply to the whole family; with a single `standards_code` per mode, `10GBASE-BX` matches the BIDI product type.

      "label": "XPBL-273396-10D Commercial 1270nm TX",

      "wavelength_min_nm": 1260.0,
      "wavelength_max_nm": 1280.0,
      "wavelength_center_nm": 1270.0,
      "standards_code": "10GBASE-BX",
      "bit_rate_gbps": 10.3125
    },
